examples.text_en: His words were congruous with the facts of the case.
examples.text_zh: 他的话与案情事实相符。

examples.text_en: The two plans are congruous in form and size.
examples.text_zh: 这两个计划在形式与规模上是一致的。

examples.text_en: A conifer keeps its green leaves all winter.
examples.text_zh: 针叶树整个冬天都保持着绿色的叶子。

examples.text_en: The tall conifer stood near the old house.
examples.text_zh: 那棵高大的针叶树矗立在老房子附近。

examples.text_en: His idea was only conjectural and not proven.
examples.text_zh: 他的想法只是推测，并未得到证实。

examples.text_en: We must not base the plan on conjectural facts.
examples.text_zh: 我们绝不能把计划建立在推测的事实之上。

examples.text_en: His conjecture about the cause was never proven.
examples.text_zh: 他关于起因的推测从未得到证实。

examples.text_en: We can only conjecture what will happen next.
examples.text_zh: 我们只能推测接下来会发生什么。

examples.text_en: The two roads conjoin near the old school.
examples.text_zh: 这两条路在老学校附近汇合。

examples.text_en: They will conjoin the two small teams into one.
examples.text_zh: 他们要把两个小组合并成一个。

examples.text_en: They shared a happy conjugal life for many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们多年来过着幸福的婚姻生活。

examples.text_en: The law speaks of conjugal rights and duties.
examples.text_zh: 法律提到了夫妻之间的权利与义务。

examples.text_en: The two words are joined by a conjunction.
examples.text_zh: 这两个词由一个连接词连在一起。

examples.text_en: He works with the police in conjunction with the school.
examples.text_zh: 他与警方配合，和学校一起工作。

examples.text_en: The old man can conjure a bird from his hat.
examples.text_zh: 这位老人能从帽子里变出一只鸟来。

examples.text_en: She tried to conjure a happy image of her home.
examples.text_zh: 她试着在脑海中想象出家乡的美好景象。

examples.text_en: The theft was done with the connivance of the guard.
examples.text_zh: 这起盗窃是在守卫的默许下发生的。

examples.text_en: He acted with the connivance of his own group.
examples.text_zh: 他在自己小组的纵容下行事。

examples.text_en: The two men will connive to hide the truth.
examples.text_zh: 这两个人会串通起来隐瞒真相。

examples.text_en: Do not connive at the bad acts of others.
examples.text_zh: 不要纵容别人的不良行为。

examples.text_en: He is a connoisseur of old books and art.
examples.text_zh: 他是古籍和艺术的鉴赏家。

examples.text_en: A true connoisseur can tell real gold at once.
examples.text_zh: 一个真正的内行一眼就能辨出真金。

examples.text_en: That word has a bad connotation for many people.
examples.text_zh: 那个词对许多人来说带有不好的含义。

examples.text_en: The name has a happy connotation in this country.
examples.text_zh: 这个名字在这个国家有着美好的含义。

examples.text_en: They began their connubial life in a small house.
examples.text_zh: 他们在一所小房子里开始了婚姻生活。

examples.text_en: The old song speaks of connubial love and joy.
examples.text_zh: 这首老歌吟唱着夫妻之间的爱与欢乐。

examples.text_en: The conqueror took the city after a long fight.
examples.text_zh: 经过长时间的战斗，征服者占领了这座城市。

examples.text_en: He was a great conqueror in the old story.
examples.text_zh: 在古老的故事里，他是一位伟大的征服者。

examples.text_en: The conquest of the city took many long years.
examples.text_zh: 征服这座城市用了许多年。

examples.text_en: His greatest conquest was the heart of a good woman.
examples.text_zh: 他最伟大的胜利是赢得了一位好女子的心。

examples.text_en: She is a conscientious worker and never wastes time.
examples.text_zh: 她是个尽责的工人，从不浪费时间。

examples.text_en: A conscientious man will do the work with care.
examples.text_zh: 有责任心的人会认真对待工作。

examples.text_en: He did not consciously make that mistake.
examples.text_zh: 他不是有意犯下那个错误的。

examples.text_en: She consciously chose the harder way to learn.
examples.text_zh: 她有意选择了更难的学习道路。

examples.text_en: The young conscript was sent far from home.
examples.text_zh: 这位年轻的被征士兵被送到了离家很远的地方。

examples.text_en: Each conscript had to learn to use a gun.
examples.text_zh: 每个被征入伍的人都得学会使用枪。

examples.text_en: They will consecrate the new church next week.
examples.text_zh: 他们下周将把新教堂奉献给神。

examples.text_en: He chose to consecrate his whole life to the poor.
examples.text_zh: 他选择把自己的一生奉献给穷人。

examples.text_en: The group reached a consensus after a long talk.
examples.text_zh: 经过长时间讨论，小组达成了共识。

examples.text_en: There is no consensus on this question yet.
examples.text_zh: 关于这个问题目前还没有一致的看法。

examples.text_en: The storm and the consequent loss hit the town.
examples.text_zh: 暴风雨以及随之而来的损失袭击了这座城镇。

examples.text_en: He was late and the consequent trouble was real.
examples.text_zh: 他迟到了，随之而来的麻烦实实在在。

examples.text_en: The decision was consequential for the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 这个决定对整个队伍关系重大。

examples.text_en: They talked about the consequential changes in the law.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论了法律中随之而来的变化。

examples.text_en: It was very cold, and consequently we stayed home.
examples.text_zh: 天气很冷，所以我们待在家里。

examples.text_en: He worked hard and consequently did very well.
examples.text_zh: 他工作努力，因此做得很好。

examples.text_en: The conservation of the old forest is very important.
examples.text_zh: 保护这片古老森林非常重要。

examples.text_en: Water conservation can save the whole town a lot.
examples.text_zh: 节约用水能为整个镇子省下很多。

examples.text_en: Conservatism can slow down a needed change.
examples.text_zh: 保守主义会拖慢必要的变革。

examples.text_en: The old party is known for its conservatism.
examples.text_zh: 这个老牌政党以其保守著称。

examples.text_en: This old method has a conservatory aim.
examples.text_zh: 这种方法带有保存的目的。

examples.text_en: The box has a conservatory effect on the food.
examples.text_zh: 这个箱子对食物有保存的作用。

examples.text_en: She made conserve from the fresh fruit.
examples.text_zh: 她用新鲜水果做了果酱。

examples.text_en: The old woman kept a pot of conserve for winter.
examples.text_zh: 老妇人留了一罐果酱准备过冬。

examples.text_en: The new house is considerably larger than the old.
examples.text_zh: 新房子比旧房子大得多。

examples.text_en: Prices went up considerably over the last year.
examples.text_zh: 过去一年里物价大幅上涨。

examples.text_en: They will consign the old books to the store.
examples.text_zh: 他们会把旧书交给那家商店。

examples.text_en: He had to consign the goods to a new buyer.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不把货物委托给一位新买家。

examples.text_en: The consolidation of the two teams took a year.
examples.text_zh: 两支队伍的合并用了一年时间。

examples.text_en: Good consolidation makes the company strong and safe.
examples.text_zh: 良好的整合使公司变得强大而稳固。

examples.text_en: There was consonance between their words and acts.
examples.text_zh: 他们的言行之间是和谐一致的。

examples.text_en: The consonance of the two songs was very pleasing.
examples.text_zh: 这两首歌的和声非常悦耳。

examples.text_en: The last letter of the word is a consonant.
examples.text_zh: 这个词的最后一个字母是辅音。

examples.text_en: A word can end with more than one consonant.
examples.text_zh: 一个词可以以不止一个辅音结尾。

examples.text_en: The queen and her consort came to the old town.
examples.text_zh: 女王和她的配偶来到了这座老城。

examples.text_en: She lived with her consort for many happy years.
examples.text_zh: 她和配偶一起度过了许多幸福的岁月。

examples.text_en: A group of banks formed a large consortium.
examples.text_zh: 几家银行组成了一个大型财团。

examples.text_en: The consortium built the new road in one year.
examples.text_zh: 这个财团一年之内建成了这条新路。

examples.text_en: The report gave a short conspectus of the work.
examples.text_zh: 报告对这项工作作了简短的概观。

examples.text_en: This book is a conspectus of the whole science.
examples.text_zh: 这本书是整门科学的大纲。

examples.text_en: The two men will conspire to take the gold.
examples.text_zh: 这两人会合谋夺取金子。

examples.text_en: Bad luck and bad work can conspire against us.
examples.text_zh: 坏运气和糟糕的工作可能共同作祟来害我们。

examples.text_en: The bad news filled the room with consternation.
examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息使满屋的人惊愕不已。

examples.text_en: To our consternation, the door was wide open.
examples.text_zh: 让我们惊愕的是，门大开着。

examples.text_en: Water is a key constituent of the whole body.
examples.text_zh: 水是整个人体的重要成分。

examples.text_en: Each constituent asked the congressman for help.
examples.text_zh: 每位选民都向这位国会议员寻求帮助。

examples.text_en: The court said the new law was constitutional.
examples.text_zh: 法院说这项新法律符合宪法。

examples.text_en: They talked about their constitutional rights at school.
examples.text_zh: 他们在学校谈论自己的宪法权利。

examples.text_en: Bad health can constrain a man for years.
examples.text_zh: 疾病能束缚一个人很多年。

examples.text_en: They did not constrain her from going out.
examples.text_zh: 他们没有阻止她外出。

examples.text_en: He felt constrained by the rules of the group.
examples.text_zh: 他感到受了小组规则的束缚。

examples.text_en: Her voice was constrained and full of fear.
examples.text_zh: 她的声音拘谨，充满恐惧。

examples.text_en: The new rules put a real constraint on us.
examples.text_zh: 新规则给我们带来真正的约束。

examples.text_en: Time is the biggest constraint on this whole job.
examples.text_zh: 时间是整个这项工作的最大限制。

examples.text_en: The cold can constrict the small blood vessels.
examples.text_zh: 寒冷会使细小的血管收缩。

examples.text_en: A tight band can constrict the arm and hurt.
examples.text_zh: 太紧的带子会勒住手臂并造成疼痛。

examples.text_en: The old road was narrow and constricted.
examples.text_zh: 这条老路又窄又狭窄受限。

examples.text_en: He felt constricted by the life of the city.
examples.text_zh: 他感到被城市生活所束缚。

examples.text_en: Cold water can constringe the soft skin.
examples.text_zh: 冷水能使柔嫩的皮肤收缩。

examples.text_en: A bitter wind may constringe the whole face.
examples.text_zh: 刺骨的寒风会使整个脸部紧缩。

examples.text_en: Please do not construe my words as a bad sign.
examples.text_zh: 请不要把我的话理解为坏的征兆。

examples.text_en: We can construe the news in two different ways.
examples.text_zh: 这条消息我们可以作两种不同的解释。

examples.text_en: The consul helped the lost people go home.
examples.text_zh: 领事帮助这些走失的人回了家。

examples.text_en: He worked as a consul in a far country.
examples.text_zh: 他在一个遥远的国家担任领事。

examples.text_en: She works for a small consultancy in the city.
examples.text_zh: 她在城里一家小型咨询公司工作。

examples.text_en: The consultancy gave the company good advice.
examples.text_zh: 这家咨询机构给公司提出了好建议。

examples.text_en: The consultant gave us a long and clear report.
examples.text_zh: 顾问给我们作了一份又长又清楚的报告。

examples.text_en: They hired a consultant to look at the problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们聘请了一位顾问来研究这个问题。

examples.text_en: She lost all her contacts when the phone broke.
examples.text_zh: 手机摔坏时，她失去了所有的联系人。

examples.text_en: He keeps his contacts in a small old book.
examples.text_zh: 他把联系人记在一个旧的小本子上。

examples.text_en: A cold can be contagious for a few days.
examples.text_zh: 感冒在几天内是具有传染性的。

examples.text_en: Her happy mood was contagious to the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 她快乐的心情感染了整个小组。

examples.text_en: The containment of the fire saved the old town.
examples.text_zh: 对火势的控制保住了这座老城。

examples.text_en: Their plan for containment of the costs worked well.
examples.text_zh: 他们控制成本的方案效果很好。

examples.text_en: The water was full of dangerous contaminants.
examples.text_zh: 水里充满了危险的污染物。

examples.text_en: They found contaminants in the food at the school.
examples.text_zh: 他们在学校的食物中发现了污染物。

examples.text_en: The contamination of the river killed many fish.
examples.text_zh: 河流的污染使许多鱼死亡。

examples.text_en: They worked hard to stop the contamination of the soil.
examples.text_zh: 他们努力阻止土壤受到污染。

examples.text_en: We should not contemn those who are poor.
examples.text_zh: 我们不应蔑视那些贫穷的人。

examples.text_en: He would contemn any act of real cruelty.
examples.text_zh: 他会蔑视任何真正残忍的行为。

examples.text_en: That was a contemptible act and we all knew it.
examples.text_zh: 那是卑鄙的行径，我们心里都清楚。

examples.text_en: He said a contemptible word about his old friend.
examples.text_zh: 他对自己的一位老朋友说了一句可鄙的话。

examples.text_en: She gave him a contemptuous look and left.
examples.text_zh: 她轻蔑地看了他一眼，然后离开了。

examples.text_en: His contemptuous words hurt the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 他轻蔑的话语伤害了整个队伍。

examples.text_en: The two teams will contend for the top prize.
examples.text_zh: 两支队伍将争夺头等奖。

examples.text_en: Many people contend that the plan will not work.
examples.text_zh: 许多人认为这项计划行不通。

examples.text_en: She is a strong contender for the top job.
examples.text_zh: 她是这个最高职位的强有力竞争者。

examples.text_en: Every contender must show skill and hard work.
examples.text_zh: 每位参赛者都必须展现出技巧和努力。

examples.text_en: Their main contention was about the use of money.
examples.text_zh: 他们的主要争论点在于资金的使用。

examples.text_en: There was much contention over the new rules.
examples.text_zh: 围绕新规则有许多争论。

examples.text_en: The meeting grew contentious after a short time.
examples.text_zh: 会议开始不久就变得争论不休。

examples.text_en: He is a contentious man and loves a good fight.
examples.text_zh: 他好争论，喜欢来一场痛快的争辩。

examples.text_en: Our two houses are contiguous on one side.
examples.text_zh: 我们两家的房子有一侧是相连的。

examples.text_en: The two countries are contiguous along the river.
examples.text_zh: 这两个国家沿着河流彼此接壤。

examples.text_en: He showed great continence in the face of desire.
examples.text_zh: 面对欲望，他表现出很强的自制力。

examples.text_en: Continence takes a strong will and much practice.
examples.text_zh: 自制需要坚强的意志和大量的练习。

examples.text_en: The continental land is large and very old.
examples.text_zh: 这片大陆的土地又大又古老。

examples.text_en: They studied the continental climate for many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究大陆性气候很多年。

examples.text_en: We must plan for every possible contingency.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须为每一种可能发生的意外做好准备。

examples.text_en: They kept some money for a sudden contingency.
examples.text_zh: 他们留了一些钱以应对突发的意外。

examples.text_en: The whole plan is contingent on the weather.
examples.text_zh: 整个计划取决于天气。

examples.text_en: Their help was contingent on our good work.
examples.text_zh: 他们的帮助取决于我们工作做得好。

examples.text_en: The continual noise made it hard to think.
examples.text_zh: 不断的噪音使人难以思考。

examples.text_en: She was tired of his continual questions.
examples.text_zh: 她厌倦了他没完没了的问题。

examples.text_en: The baby cried continually through the whole night.
examples.text_zh: 这个婴儿整晚不停地哭。

examples.text_en: He is continually late for work in the morning.
examples.text_zh: 他早上上班总是迟到。

examples.text_en: This book is a continuation of the first one.
examples.text_zh: 这本书是第一本的续集。

examples.text_en: The rain was a continuation of the same bad weather.
examples.text_zh: 这场雨是同样恶劣天气的延续。

examples.text_en: The new teacher gave the class real continuity.
examples.text_zh: 新老师给这个班带来了真正的连续性。

examples.text_en: There is no continuity between the two parts.
examples.text_zh: 这两部分之间没有连续性。

examples.text_en: Time is a continuum that has no clear end.
examples.text_zh: 时间是一个没有明确终点的连续体。

examples.text_en: Health and illness form a single continuum.
examples.text_zh: 健康与疾病构成一个连续的谱系。

examples.text_en: He can contort his face into a funny shape.
examples.text_zh: 他能把脸扭曲成滑稽的形状。

examples.text_en: The strong wind made the old tree contort.
examples.text_zh: 大风使那棵老树扭曲变形。

examples.text_en: The contour of the hills was clear at sunset.
examples.text_zh: 日落时群山的轮廓清晰可见。

examples.text_en: She drew the contour of his face in one line.
examples.text_zh: 她用一笔画出了他脸部的轮廓。

examples.text_en: The police found contraband in the old car.
examples.text_zh: 警方在那辆旧车里发现了违禁品。

examples.text_en: They tried to bring contraband over the border.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图把违禁品带过边境。

examples.text_en: The contraction of the metal made the door hard to open.
examples.text_zh: 金属的收缩使这扇门难以打开。

examples.text_en: A contraction can join two words into one short form.
examples.text_zh: 缩写式可以把两个词合并成一种简短形式。

examples.text_en: The company signed several contracts with the new team.
examples.text_zh: 公司与新团队签订了几份合同。

examples.text_en: He keeps all his old contracts in a small box.
examples.text_zh: 他把自己所有的旧合同都放在一个小盒子里。

examples.text_en: Please do not contradict me in front of the children.
examples.text_zh: 请不要在孩子们面前反驳我。

examples.text_en: The new facts contradict the old story.
examples.text_zh: 新的事实与旧的说法相矛盾。

examples.text_en: We got two contradictory answers to the same question.
examples.text_zh: 对同一个问题，我们得到了两个互相矛盾的回答。

examples.text_en: His acts were contradictory to his own words.
examples.text_zh: 他的行为与他自己的话相矛盾。

examples.text_en: Such an act would contravene the law of the land.
examples.text_zh: 这种行为会违反本国的法律。

examples.text_en: They did not contravene the rules of the school.
examples.text_zh: 他们没有违反学校的规章。

examples.text_en: He was contrite and said he was very sorry.
examples.text_zh: 他后悔了，说自己非常抱歉。

examples.text_en: Her contrite words made the old man smile.
examples.text_zh: 她悔过的话让那位老人笑了。

examples.text_en: He showed real contrition for what he had done.
examples.text_zh: 他对自己做过的事表现出真诚的悔悟。

examples.text_en: Her tears were a sign of true contrition.
examples.text_zh: 她的眼泪是真心悔改的表示。

examples.text_en: They tried to contrive a plan to save the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法筹划一个计划来拯救这座城镇。

examples.text_en: She can contrive a way to finish the work early.
examples.text_zh: 她能想出办法提早完成工作。

examples.text_en: The new law caused a great controversy in the country.
examples.text_zh: 这项新法律在国内引起了很大的争论。

examples.text_en: There was much controversy about the plan for the school.
examples.text_zh: 关于这所学校的计划有许多争议。

examples.text_en: He tried to controvert the claims of the report.
examples.text_zh: 他试图驳斥报告中的说法。

examples.text_en: She will controvert his view in the next meeting.
examples.text_zh: 她将在下次会议上辩驳他的观点。

examples.text_en: The contumacious man would not obey any order.
examples.text_zh: 这个抗命的人不肯服从任何命令。

examples.text_en: A contumacious child can make the class hard.
examples.text_zh: 一个不听话的孩子会让课堂变得难管。

examples.text_en: His contumacy led to a long stay in prison.
examples.text_zh: 他的抗命导致他长期入狱。

examples.text_en: The court will not accept such contumacy.
examples.text_zh: 法庭不会接受这样的拒不服从。

examples.text_en: He had to bear the contumely of the whole crowd.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不忍受整个人群的侮辱。

examples.text_en: Her words were full of contumely and hate.
examples.text_zh: 她的话充满侮辱和憎恨。

examples.text_en: He went to the country to convalesce after the illness.
examples.text_zh: 病后他到乡下去休养康复。

examples.text_en: She needs a quiet place to convalesce for a month.
examples.text_zh: 她需要一个安静的地方康复一个月。

examples.text_en: The convalescent man could walk only a little.
examples.text_zh: 这位正在康复的人只能走一小段路。

examples.text_en: She was still in the convalescent stage of her illness.
examples.text_zh: 她仍处于疾病的康复期。

examples.text_en: The convection of heat made the whole room warm.
examples.text_zh: 热的对流传整个房间变得温暖。

examples.text_en: Convection can move the air in a closed room.
examples.text_zh: 对流能使封闭房间里的空气流动。

examples.text_en: The group will convene in the old hall at noon.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体中午将在旧礼堂集合。

examples.text_en: They will convene a meeting to talk about the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们将召集一次会议来讨论这项计划。

examples.text_en: He dressed conventionally for the old school party.
examples.text_zh: 他按照惯例盛装出席老学校的聚会。

examples.text_en: This work is conventionally done in a simple way.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作通常以简单的方式来完成。

examples.text_en: The two roads converge near the old town.
examples.text_zh: 这两条路在老镇附近汇合。

examples.text_en: Many people will converge on the city for the game.
examples.text_zh: 许多人将为了这场比赛汇聚到这座城市。

examples.text_en: The two lines are convergent at one clear point.
examples.text_zh: 这两条线在一个明确的点上相交。

examples.text_en: Their ideas were convergent on almost every point.
examples.text_zh: 他们的想法几乎在每一点上都是一致的。

examples.text_en: She is conversant with the old rules of the game.
examples.text_zh: 她熟悉这个游戏的旧规则。

examples.text_en: He is well conversant with the history of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他对这座城镇的历史非常熟悉。

examples.text_en: Her conversational style made the class easy and fun.
examples.text_zh: 她口语化的风格使课堂轻松有趣。

examples.text_en: We had a short conversational talk about the news.
examples.text_zh: 我们就这条新闻进行了一次简短的对话。

examples.text_en: He is quiet; conversely, his brother talks a lot.
examples.text_zh: 他性格安静，相反，他弟弟话很多。

examples.text_en: Good work brings success; conversely, poor work brings loss.
examples.text_zh: 好的工作带来成功，相反，差的工作带来损失。

examples.text_en: The old converter can change the gas into liquid.
examples.text_zh: 这台旧转换器能把气体变成液体。

examples.text_en: A power converter is needed for this small machine.
examples.text_zh: 这台小机器需要一个电源转换器。

examples.text_en: A bus is a common conveyance in this city.
examples.text_zh: 在这座城市里，公共汽车是常见的交通工具。

examples.text_en: They need some form of conveyance to reach the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们需要某种运输工具才能到达那个镇子。

examples.text_en: The convict was kept in a small dark room.
examples.text_zh: 这名囚犯被关在一间又小又暗的房间里。

examples.text_en: The old convict told the young men his story.
examples.text_zh: 这位老囚犯向这些年轻人讲了自己的经历。
